items.quote: The current expansion is being supported through the internal accruals. So fortunately, we have very good cash accruals. So for this 2.2 gigawatt, we are not raising any equity.

items.statement: Planning INR500 crores equity raise for cell and module expansion within 2-3 months
items.quote: We are approaching investors to raise. So I think so within 2 to 3 months, we will be approaching investors to raise this INR500 crores.
